data.body:
[P2] Reconsider the unused gate callback branches

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, is broken by the `on_release` dispatch here and the corresponding `on_hold` dispatch. No fixture call or test supplies either callback, so deleting these branches leaves every supplied assertion unchanged. They expand the fault-timing contract without demonstrated use or coverage. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and narrow the gate contract to the active scenarios, or establish why these hooks are required and how their behavior will be verified.
